subTasks.label: Filter workshops by user level
subTasks.detail: Filtered out Newcomer/Novice workshops and Advanced/All-Star workshops. Retained Intermediate workshops and All Levels sessions.

subTasks.label: Filter competitions by division
subTasks.detail: Included Intermediate Jack & Jill Prelims and Finals. Marked Novice, Masters, Advanced, All-Star, and Champions divisions as spectator/filtered events.

subTasks.label: Apply buffer timeline
subTasks.detail: Integrated flight arrival deadline of 2:15 PM on Friday, September 25th based on 5:15 PM earliest staging time.

sessions.title: Registration Opens
sessions.justification: Required for event check-in and pass collection.

sessions.justification: Unique cultural workshops open to all dancers.

sessions.title: Intermediate Workshop (Jung Choe)
sessions.justification: Perfect match for your intermediate workshop preference.

sessions.title: Newcomer/Novice Workshop (Joseph Tong)
sessions.justification: Below user's intermediate skill level choice.

sessions.title: Intermediate Workshop (Alex Kim)
sessions.justification: Matches user's intermediate level workshop preferences.

sessions.title: Intermediate Jack & Jill Prelims
sessions.justification: Target competitive division chosen by user.

sessions.title: Intermediate Jack & Jill Finals
sessions.justification: Your targeted competitive division final (either competing or supporting peers).

sessions.title: All Levels Workshop (Dave Kahn)
sessions.justification: Open to all levels; great recovery workshop.

sessions.title: All Levels Workshop (Janelle & Skylar)
sessions.justification: Final technical session of the event.

## 🌺 The Aloha Open 2026
### My Personalized Schedule (Intermediate Level)

---

### ✈️ Travel & Friday Arrival (Sept 25)
- **2:15 PM**: ✈️ Latest Safe Flight Landing Time
- **2:45 PM**: Hotel Check-In & Settle (Wailea Beach Resort)
- **3:00 PM**: Registration Opens (Lokalani Ballroom Foyer) 
- **4:15 PM**: Warmup & Prep
- **5:00 PM**: Hawaiian Blessing
- **5:30 PM**: Opening Ceremonies
- **6:00 PM**: Wahine/Kane Hula Workshop
- **8:00 PM**: All Aloha J&J Prelims & Finals
- **9:30 PM**: Social Dancing (Dress Code: **Tropical / Aloha patterns**)

---

### 👟 Saturday Workshops & Competition (Sept 26)
- **10:00 AM**: Breathwork & Meditation Class
- **11:00 AM**: **Intermediate Workshop** (Jung Choe) - Lokalani 2
- **12:00 PM**: *Break / Practice* (Novice & Advanced workshops filtered out)
- **1:00 PM**: Lunch Break & Open Dancing
- **3:00 PM**: **Intermediate Workshop** (Alex Kim) - Lokalani 1
- **4:00 PM**: 🏆 **Intermediate Jack & Jill Prelims**
- **6:00 PM**: 🍽️ Ticketed Dinner & Live Music
- **8:00 PM**: 🏆 **Intermediate Jack & Jill Finals**
- **11:00 PM**: Awards 
- **11:30 PM - 2:00 AM**: Late Night Social Dancing

---

### 🌊 Sunday Recovery (Sept 27)
- **11:00 AM**: All Levels Workshop (Dave Kahn)
- **12:00 PM**: All Levels Workshop (Jesse & Aerial)
- **1:00 PM**: Lunch Break
- **2:00 PM**: All Levels Workshop (Janelle & Skylar)
- **3:00 PM**: Social Dancing & Goodbyes
